items.title: Properness and universal closedness are preserved by base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that the base change of a proper morphism is proper, and that the same holds for universally closed morphisms. The proof verifies the three constituents of the definition one after another: universal closedness is preserved by base change by definition, separatedness is preserved by base change by the corresponding lemma on separated morphisms, and being of finite type is preserved by base change by the base change lemma for finite type; properness, being the conjunction of the three, follows.
